name: market_analysis
summary: What a USED / second-hand item really sells for (resale value; 'was ist mein … noch wert', Gebrauchtpreis, Wiederverkaufswert, 'was zahlt man gebraucht für …'): eBay sold prices (median, typical range, number of sales) plus asking prices on willhaben / Kleinanzeigen. Use for 'what is my … worth', 'what do people pay for a used …', 'how much should I ask for my …'. Not for new retail prices (research).

args.item: string: the exact item (brand, model, generation, size) — no price or place
args.country: at | de (default at): which classifieds site gives asking prices
